store.bytes_per_commit_spine.small.status: known breach, bounded, awaiting its fix
store.bytes_per_commit_spine.small.why: the harness bills every non-cache table to a budget whose byte model is the commit tables: on this corpus at the epic's close `graph_*` is 6,865 B/commit of the ~8,275 measured (49.8 % of the store is the graph lane), while `git_commit` + `git_commit_file` + `ref_tip` are 1,376 B/commit. The number also moves with how much of the lane one gate run happens to write (8,289 at 3 samples, 10,446 at 5), which is the same defect talking. ADR-004 §11.6 gives the lane its own budget (`store.bytes_per_commit_graph`, 32 KiB/revision) and `perf_gate.py` has never measured it. ADR-004 §11.10; delete this row when reco-7yq gives `store_split` the ADR's three denominators.
